title: Preamble Detector
text: Detect preamble in data packet, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Input}, {Preamble}, {Detection threshold}, {Output detection metric} sets the option to output detection metric, {Detections} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Index of last preamble symbol [ ] | scalar | column vector

params.name: Output detection metric
params.values: Option to output detection metric off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
